```{r}
# Load required packages
#library(phyloseq)
#library(picante)
#library(vegan)
#library(tidyverse)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Function to estimate alpha diversity over 1,000 rarefactions
estimate_alpha_diversity_iterative <- function(physeq_obj, depth = 14983, iter = 1000) {
  # Check that depth is valid
  min_lib_size <- min(sample_sums(physeq_obj))
  if (depth > min_lib_size) {
    stop("Rarefaction depth exceeds minimum library size.")
  }

  # Store metrics from each iteration
  alpha_list <- vector("list", iter)

  for (i in 1:iter) {
    rarefied <- rarefy_even_depth(physeq_obj, sample.size = depth, verbose = FALSE, rngseed = 123 + i)

    # Get OTU matrix (samples as rows)
    otu <- as(otu_table(rarefied), "matrix")
    if (taxa_are_rows(rarefied)) otu <- t(otu)
    
    tree <- phy_tree(rarefied)

    richness <- estimate_richness(rarefied, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "InvSimpson"))
    pd_vals  <- pd(otu, tree, include.root = FALSE)

    metrics <- cbind(richness, Faith_PD = pd_vals$PD)
    metrics$Sample <- rownames(metrics)
    alpha_list[[i]] <- metrics
  }

  # Average across all iterations
  alpha_combined <- bind_rows(alpha_list)
  alpha_summary <- alpha_combined %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    summarise(across(c(Observed, Shannon, InvSimpson, Faith_PD), mean, na.rm = TRUE))

  return(alpha_summary)
}

# Run the function using physeq_no_growout3 and rarefaction depth of 14,983
alpha_diversity_summary <- estimate_alpha_diversity_iterative(physeq_no_growout3, depth = 14983, iter = 1000)

# View result
head(alpha_diversity_summary)
```

```{r}
##Now, for the statistics
#library(dplyr)
#library(tidyr)
#library(ggplot2)
#library(MASS)
#library(glmmTMB)
#library(DHARMa)

##First, let's determine the best-fitting distribution

# Alpha diversity metrics to test
metrics <- c("Observed", "Shannon", "InvSimpson", "Faith_PD")

# Initialize a list to store the results
distribution_fits <- list()

# Loop through each metric and growout
for (metric in metrics) {
  for (g in c("1", "2")) {
    # Filter the data for the specific growout directly from alpha_diversity_meta
    df_sub <- alpha_diversity_meta %>% 
      filter(Growout == g)
    
    # Extract the vector of values for the current metric
    y <- df_sub[[metric]]
    
    cat("\n----------------------------\n")
    cat(paste("Metric:", metric, "| Growout:", g, "\n"))

    # Shapiro-Wilk normality test
    shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(y)
    cat("Shapiro-Wilk p-value:", round(shapiro_result$p.value, 4), "\n")
    
    # Visual histogram
    p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes_string(x = metric)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
      ggtitle(paste(metric, "- Growout", g))
    print(p)
    
    # Attempt to fit different statistical distributions
    dist_fits <- list()
    try(dist_fits$normal <- fitdistr(y, "normal"), silent = TRUE)
    try(dist_fits$gamma  <- fitdistr(y, "gamma"), silent = TRUE)
    try(dist_fits$lognorm <- fitdistr(y, "lognormal"), silent = TRUE)
    
    # Compare model fits using AIC (Akaike Information Criterion)
    aics <- sapply(dist_fits, AIC)
    best_fit <- names(which.min(aics))
    cat("Best distribution (AIC):", best_fit, "\n")
    
    # Store the AICs and the name of the best-fitting distribution
    distribution_fits[[paste(metric, g, sep = "_")]] <- list(
      AICs = aics,
      Best = best_fit
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
##We will now construct models and generate diagnostics to ensure appropriate fit

# 1. Specify best distributions per metric and growout based on AIC
best_distributions <- list(
  Observed    = c("1" = "gamma",   "2" = "normal"),
  Shannon     = c("1" = "gamma",   "2" = "normal"),
  InvSimpson  = c("1" = "lognorm", "2" = "gamma"),
  Faith_PD    = c("1" = "gamma",   "2" = "gamma")
)

# 2. Helper to choose the appropriate family/link
get_glmm_family <- function(dist_name) {
  if (dist_name == "gamma") {
    Gamma(link = "log")
  } else if (dist_name == "normal") {
    gaussian(link = "identity")
  } else if (dist_name == "lognorm") {
    # we'll log-transform the response instead
    gaussian(link = "identity")
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported distribution: ", dist_name)
  }
}

# 3. Smart GLMM fit with Position as fixed and only House as random
fit_smart_glmm <- function(metric, growout, dist_name,
                           var_thresh = 1e-6,
                           n_dharma   = 1000) {
  # Subset & factorize
  df <- alpha_diversity_meta %>%
    filter(Growout == growout) %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = factor(Treatment),
      House     = factor(House),
      Position  = factor(Position)
    )
  
  # Log-transform if lognormal
  if (dist_name == "lognorm") {
    df[[metric]] <- log(df[[metric]])
  }
  
  # Full formula: Treatment + Position fixed, House random
  form_full <- reformulate(
    c("Treatment", "Position", "(1|House)"),
    response = metric
  )
  fam <- get_glmm_family(dist_name)
  
  # Initial fit
  model <- glmmTMB(form_full, family = fam, data = df)
  
  # Check House variance
  vc       <- VarCorr(model)$cond
  house_var <- if ("House" %in% names(vc)) vc$House[1,1] else 0
  
  # Decide whether to keep the House random effect
  if (house_var <= var_thresh) {
    # drop random effect if near zero
    form_simp <- reformulate(
      c("Treatment", "Position"),
      response = metric
    )
    model <- glmmTMB(form_simp, family = fam, data = df)
    cat("  Dropped (1|House); using fixed only\n")
  }
  
  # DHARMa diagnostics
  cat("\n--- DHARMa Diagnostics:", metric, "| Growout", growout, "---\n")
  sim <- simulateResiduals(model, n = n_dharma)
  print(testDispersion(sim))
  print(testOutliers(sim))
  print(testQuantiles(sim))
  plot(sim, main = paste(metric, "(Growout", growout, ")"))
  
  return(model)
}

# 4. Loop over metrics and growouts, fit & store models
models <- list()
for (met in names(best_distributions)) {
  for (go in c("1", "2")) {
    dist <- best_distributions[[met]][[go]]
    name <- paste0(met, "_G", go)
    cat("\n============================\n",
        "Fitting:", name, "| Distribution:", dist, "\n")
    models[[name]] <- fit_smart_glmm(met, go, dist)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# 1) Harmonize alpha_long’s Metric
alpha_long2 <- alpha_long %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = case_when(
      Metric %in% c("Faith_PD", "Faith’s PD", "Faith's PD") ~ "Faith’s PD",
      TRUE ~ Metric
    ),
    Growout = as.character(Growout)
  )

# 2) Extract p-values for Treatment only
p_values_df <- imap_dfr(models, function(mod, name) {
  parts   <- strsplit(name, "_G")[[1]]
  metric  <- parts[1]
  growout <- parts[2]

  # get fixed-effects table, conditional model
  fe_tbl <- tidy(mod, components = "cond", effects = "fixed")

  # filter for Treatment effect only (e.g. "TreatmentIndigoLT")
  pval <- fe_tbl %>%
    filter(grepl("^Treatment", term)) %>%
    # if you have exactly one Treatment term, pull it; otherwise it'll error
    pull(p.value)

  tibble(
    Metric  = metric,
    Growout = growout,
    P_Value = pval
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    # recode Faith_PD label
    Metric = case_when(
      Metric %in% c("Faith_PD", "Faith’s PD", "Faith's PD") ~ "Faith’s PD",
      TRUE ~ Metric
    ),
    Growout = as.character(Growout),
    P_Value_Label = sprintf("italic(p) == %.3f", P_Value)
  )

    .groups = "drop"
```

```{r}
# Metrics to evaluate
metrics_joint <- c("Observed", "Shannon", "InvSimpson", "Faith_PD")

# New container so we don't touch your prior 'distribution_fits'
distribution_fits_joint <- list()

for (metric in metrics_joint) {
  for (g in c("1","2")) {
    df_sub <- alpha_diversity_meta %>%
      dplyr::filter(Growout == g)

    y <- df_sub[[metric]]

    cat("\n----------------------------\n")
    cat(paste("Metric:", metric, "| Growout:", g, "\n"))

    # Shapiro-Wilk
    shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(y)
    cat("Shapiro-Wilk p-value:", round(shapiro_result$p.value, 4), "\n")

    # Quick histogram
    print(
      ggplot(df_sub, aes_string(x = metric)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
        ggtitle(paste(metric, "- Growout", g))
    )

    # Fit candidate distributions
    dist_fits <- list()
    try(dist_fits$normal  <- MASS::fitdistr(y, "normal"),    silent = TRUE)
    try(dist_fits$gamma   <- MASS::fitdistr(y, "gamma"),     silent = TRUE)
    try(dist_fits$lognorm <- MASS::fitdistr(y, "lognormal"), silent = TRUE)

    aics <- sapply(dist_fits, AIC)
    best <- names(which.min(aics))
    cat("Best distribution (AIC):", best, "\n")

    distribution_fits_joint[[paste(metric, g, sep = "_")]] <- list(
      AICs = aics, Best = best
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## Global α-diversity models across Growout 1 & 2
## Fixed: Treatment * Growout + Position
## Random: (1 | Growout:House)   [dropped if near-zero variance]
## Families (from your AIC screen):
##   Observed   -> normal
##   Shannon    -> gamma
##   InvSimpson -> lognormal (log-transform + Gaussian)
##   Faith_PD   -> gamma
## Outputs (no overwrite): 
##   alpha_models_joint_new, alpha_pairs_joint_new, 
##   alpha_anova_joint_new,  alpha_dharma_joint_new
## ============================================================

# ---- 0) Checks & setup ----
.required_cols <- c("Sample","Growout","Treatment","House","Position",
                    "Observed","Shannon","InvSimpson","Faith_PD")
.missing <- setdiff(.required_cols, names(alpha_diversity_meta))
if (length(.missing)) {
  stop("alpha_diversity_meta is missing required columns: ", paste(.missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# Local copy (avoid mutating your original data frame)
.alpha_df_joint <- alpha_diversity_meta
.alpha_df_joint$Growout   <- as.factor(.alpha_df_joint$Growout)
.alpha_df_joint$Treatment <- as.factor(.alpha_df_joint$Treatment)
.alpha_df_joint$House     <- as.factor(.alpha_df_joint$House)
.alpha_df_joint$Position  <- as.factor(.alpha_df_joint$Position)

# Sum-to-zero contrasts for Type III
.old_contr <- options(contrasts = c("contr.sum","contr.poly"))

# Families you chose from the console results
families_map <- c(
  Observed   = "normal",
  Shannon    = "gamma",
  InvSimpson = "lognorm",  # log-transform + Gaussian
  Faith_PD   = "gamma"
)

# ---- 1) Helpers ----
.get_family <- function(fam_name) {
  if (fam_name == "normal")   return(stats::gaussian(link = "identity"))
  if (fam_name == "gamma")    return(stats::Gamma(link = "log"))
  if (fam_name == "lognorm")  return(stats::gaussian(link = "identity"))  # via log-transform
  stop("Unsupported family: ", fam_name)
}

.extract_rand_var <- function(model) {
  vc <- try(glmmTMB::VarCorr(model), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vc, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)
  vcdf <- try(as.data.frame(vc), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vcdf, "try-error") || !nrow(vcdf)) return(NA_real_)
  row <- vcdf[vcdf$component == "cond" & grepl("Growout:House", vcdf$grp), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(row)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(row$sdcor[1])^2  # SD^2 -> variance
}

.fit_one_metric_joint <- function(metric, fam_name, var_thresh = 1e-6, n_sims = 1000) {
  df <- .alpha_df_joint

  # Build response (log-transform if lognormal)
  resp_var <- if (fam_name == "lognorm") paste0("log_", metric) else metric
  if (fam_name == "lognorm") {
    if (any(df[[metric]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      stop("'", metric, "' contains non-positive values; cannot log-transform for lognormal.")
    }
    df[[resp_var]] <- log(df[[metric]])
  } else {
    df[[resp_var]] <- df[[metric]]
  }

  fam <- .get_family(fam_name)

  # Full formula with random effect
  form_full <- stats::as.formula(paste0(resp_var, " ~ Treatment * Growout + Position + (1 | Growout:House)"))
  model_full <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(form_full, family = fam, data = df)

  # Drop random effect if essentially zero variance
  kept_random <- TRUE
  rv <- .extract_rand_var(model_full)
  if (!is.na(rv) && rv <= var_thresh) {
    kept_random <- FALSE
    form_simpl <- stats::as.formula(paste0(resp_var, " ~ Treatment * Growout + Position"))
    model_full <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(form_simpl, family = fam, data = df)
  }

  # Type III Wald tests
  a3 <- car::Anova(model_full, type = 3)

  # emmeans: Treatment within Growout + BH-adjusted pairwise via contrast()
  emm_by <- emmeans::emmeans(model_full, ~ Treatment | Growout)
  pw     <- emmeans::contrast(emm_by, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
  pw_df  <- as.data.frame(summary(pw))
  pw_df$Metric <- metric

  # DHARMa diagnostics
  simres <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_full, n = n_sims)
  disp   <- DHARMa::testDispersion(simres)
  outs   <- DHARMa::testOutliers(simres)
  quants <- DHARMa::testQuantiles(simres)

  list(
    metric       = metric,
    family_used  = fam_name,
    transform    = if (fam_name == "lognorm") "log" else "none",
    kept_random  = kept_random,
    model        = model_full,
    anova3       = a3,
    emmeans      = emm_by,
    pairs_contr  = pw,
    pairs_df     = pw_df,
    dharma       = list(sim = simres, dispersion = disp, outliers = outs, quantiles = quants)
  )
}

# ---- 2) Fit all four metrics (no overwrite; use *_new names) ----
alpha_models_joint_new <- lapply(names(families_map), function(met) {
  .fit_one_metric_joint(metric = met, fam_name = families_map[[met]])
})
names(alpha_models_joint_new) <- names(families_map)

# ---- 3) Collect outputs ----
alpha_pairs_joint_new <- do.call(rbind, lapply(alpha_models_joint_new, `[[`, "pairs_df"))
row.names(alpha_pairs_joint_new) <- NULL

alpha_anova_joint_new <- lapply(alpha_models_joint_new, function(x) {
  out <- as.data.frame(x$anova3)
  out$Term   <- rownames(out)
  out$Metric <- x$metric
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out[, c("Metric","Term", setdiff(names(out), c("Metric","Term")))]
})

alpha_dharma_joint_new <- lapply(alpha_models_joint_new, `[[`, "dharma")

# ---- 4) Console summaries (optional) ----
invisible(lapply(alpha_models_joint_new, function(x) {
  cat("\n==============================\n",
      "Metric: ", x$metric,
      " | family=", x$family_used,
      " | transform=", x$transform,
      " | kept_random=", x$kept_random, "\n", sep = "")
  print(x$anova3)
  cat("\n-- Pairwise: Treatment within Growout (BH) --\n")
  print(summary(x$pairs_contr))
  cat("\n-- DHARMa --\n")
  print(x$dharma$dispersion)
  print(x$dharma$outliers)
  print(x$dharma$quantiles)
}))

# Restore original contrasts
options(.old_contr)

```

```{r}
## ===============================
## Pairwise p-value overlay plot
## ===============================

# -- helper to format p-values for plotmath --
fmt_p_parse <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("italic(p)==NA")
  if (p < 1e-3) sprintf("italic(p)==%s", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 3))
  else sprintf("italic(p)==%.3f", p)
}

# -------- 1) Build a long plotting frame (no overwrite) ----------
alpha_long_plot <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  alpha_diversity_meta,
  cols = c("Observed","Shannon","InvSimpson","Faith_PD"),
  names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric  = dplyr::case_when(
      Metric %in% c("Faith_PD","Faith’s PD","Faith's PD") ~ "Faith’s PD",
      TRUE ~ Metric
    ),
    Growout = as.character(Growout),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment)
  )

# -------- 2) Extract BH pairwise p-values (Control vs IndigoLT) from your joint models ----------
# Use your fitted joint models object (the one you just ran)
models_list_for_plot <- alpha_models_joint_new

alpha_pairs_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(models_list_for_plot, function(one, metric_name) {
  # each 'one' is a list with $pairs_df created earlier by emmeans::contrast(..., adjust="BH")
  pwdf <- try(one$pairs_df, silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(pwdf, "try-error") || is.null(pwdf) || !nrow(pwdf)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(Metric = metric_name, Growout = character(), P_Value = numeric()))
  }

  # Keep Control vs IndigoLT comparisons and carry Growout
  keep <- grepl("Control\\s*-\\s*IndigoLT|IndigoLT\\s*-\\s*Control", pwdf$contrast)
  pwdf <- pwdf[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(pwdf)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(Metric = metric_name, Growout = character(), P_Value = numeric()))
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    Metric  = metric_name,
    Growout = as.character(pwdf$Growout),
    P_Value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pwdf$p.value))
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric  = dplyr::case_when(
      Metric %in% c("Faith_PD","Faith’s PD","Faith's PD") ~ "Faith’s PD",
      TRUE ~ Metric
    ),
    Growout = as.character(Growout),
    P_Label = vapply(P_Value, fmt_p_parse, character(1))
  )

# -------- 3) y-positions for the p-value text ----------
p_ypos_df <- alpha_long_plot %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Metric, Growout) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(y_pos = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.02, .groups = "drop")

alpha_pairs_annot <- dplyr::left_join(alpha_pairs_df, p_ypos_df, by = c("Metric","Growout"))

# -------- 4) Plot (faceted by Metric) with pairwise p-values overlaid ----------
alpha_pair_plot_new <- ggplot(alpha_long_plot, aes(x = Growout, y = Value)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Treatment),
               color = "black", alpha = 0.9,
               outlier.shape = NA,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  stat_summary(aes(fill = Treatment),
               fun = mean, geom = "point",
               shape = 23, size = 3, color = "white",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Treatment),
              shape     = 21,
              size      = 1.25,
              alpha     = 0.9,
              fill      = "white",
              position  = position_jitterdodge(
                            jitter.width = 0.1,
                            dodge.width  = 0.9),
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = alpha_pairs_annot,
            aes(x = Growout, y = y_pos, label = P_Label),
            parse = TRUE, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#f8765c", "IndigoLT" = "#221150")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control"  = "black",
                                "IndigoLT" = "black")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position  = "top",
    panel.spacing    = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(fill = "Treatment", x = "Growout")

print(alpha_pair_plot_new)

 ggsave("alpha_pairwise_BH_pvalues_joint.3.png", alpha_pair_plot_new,
        width = 6.5, height = 3, units = "in", dpi = 900)


```
